result.instructions: Tools for D7 Networks, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "How much credit is left on my text messaging account?"; "What is the price per text message to the United Arab Emirates?"; "Show the text message prices for every country on my account.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes D7 Networks data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run d7_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run d7_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run d7_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. d7_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: d7_get_balance
tools.title: Get credit balance
tools.description: Read the D7 account's remaining credit balance (free; no credit is spent). D7 REST: GET /messages/v1/balance.

tools.name: d7_get_sms_pricing
tools.title: Get SMS pricing
tools.description: Read the account's price per SMS part, for one country or for all countries (free; no credit is spent). Use it to estimate the cost before d7_send_sms. D7 REST: GET /messages/v1/sms/pricing.

country_iso.description: Two-letter ISO country code, for example AE. Omit for all countries.

tools.name: d7_get_message_status
tools.title: Get SMS delivery status
tools.description: Read the delivery status of an SMS request: per recipient the status (delivered, sent, scheduled, un_delivered, not_reachable, spam_content, insufficient_credit), message parts and cost (free). D7 REST: GET /report/v1/message-log/{request_id}.

tools.name: d7_get_lookup_report
tools.title: Get number lookup report
tools.description: Read the stored result of an earlier number lookup by its request_id (free; no credit is spent). D7 REST: GET /hlr/v1/report/{request_id}.

tools.name: d7_lookup_number
tools.title: Look up a phone number (costs credits)
tools.description: WRITE (spends credits): look up ONE phone number's carrier data (country, network, MCC/MNC, ported, reachable, mobile or fixed). Each lookup is billed to the D7 account's credit balance (the cost is returned by d7_get_lookup_report as number_lookup_cost) and the account must have lookup routing enabled. It does not message the number. D7 REST: POST /hlr/v1/lookup.

recipient.description: The phone number, international format with the country code, for example +971501234567.

annotations.title: Look up a phone number (costs credits)

tools.name: d7_send_sms
tools.title: Send an SMS (spends credits)
tools.description: WRITE (sends real text messages and spends credits): send ONE text message to 1-10 recipients (never a list or campaign). Each recipient costs the per-country price for every message part (about 160 GSM characters or 70 unicode characters per part; see d7_get_sms_pricing), taken from the D7 credit balance, and a sent SMS cannot be recalled. Free trial accounts may only use D7's demo sender id; other sender ids must be registered with D7. Send only messages the recipients expect, as unsolicited SMS violates D7's terms. Returns a request_id for d7_get_message_status. D7 REST: POST /messages/v1/send.

originator.description: Sender id shown on the phone: up to 11 letters/digits (alphanumeric) or a registered number. Must be allowed for the account.

recipients.description: 1 to 10 phone numbers, each in international format with the country code, for example +971501234567.

content.description: The message text, at most 640 characters.

data_coding.description: text = GSM 03.38 characters only, unicode = Arabic/Chinese/emoji etc., auto (default) = D7 decides from the content.

tag.description: Your own reference string, stored with the request.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with D7 Networks
prompts.description: What you can do with D7 Networks here, with example requests to try.

prompts.name: check_how_much_credit_is_left
prompts.title: Check how much credit is left
prompts.description: The AI reads the remaining credit balance of the D7 account. Reading it spends no credit.

prompts.name: look_up_the_price_per_sms_for_a_country
prompts.title: Look up the price per SMS for a country
prompts.description: The AI reads the price per SMS part for one country or for all countries on your account. You can estimate a cost before you send.

prompts.name: check_whether_a_text_message_was_delivered
prompts.title: Check whether a text message was delivered
prompts.description: The AI reads the delivery status of an SMS request for each recipient, such as delivered, not reachable or insufficient credit, with message parts and cost.

prompts.name: look_up_a_phone_number_s_carrier_data
prompts.title: Look up a phone number's carrier data
prompts.description: The AI looks up one phone number for country, network, MCC/MNC, ported and reachable status. Each lookup uses credit; an earlier lookup can be re-read by request id.

prompts.name: send_one_text_message_to_up_to_10_recipients
prompts.title: Send one text message to up to 10 recipients
prompts.description: The AI sends one SMS to 1 to 10 recipients. It can check the price per country first. Each message part uses credit.
